content:
**Foxes** are creatures found in Appalachia.

Red foxes are native to North America. [1] 

Foxes will not actually attack the player character, they will instead run away when approached. They often stick together in packs.

| Name (Form ID) | Abilities | Items | 
| **Fox**00017DC8 EncCritterFox01Template | | | 

| Melee (0 ) | 

- A trio of foxes appear at Big Fred's BBQ Shack.
- A chance to appear south of Hornwright Summer Villa and east of Torrance House.
- At the intersection of state routes 95 and 98, up the hill from Palace of the Winding Path.

Foxes are mentioned by Swank. [2] 

Foxes appear only in *Fallout 76* and are mentioned in *Fallout: New Vegas*.
